aim_conventions.authored: Full original transforms preserve roll. Their target markers lie one unit along the original optical axis; they are not instructions to re-aim at the common target.
aim_conventions.other: A missing matrix uses the declared look-at target and world-Z up. Native arrays retain actual calibration. Runtime reads ordinary saved USD camera transforms.

calibration.note: A focal pixels approximately 554.256, B 732.999. Unchanged across layouts; symmetric poses do not imply identical fields of view.

definitions.coarse: 13 physical scenes / 31 objects per layout: 12 static scenes / 28 targets and one 3-object temporal scene. Four frames per static scene and 12 temporal frames give 60 native samples per layout, 600 across ten layouts.
definitions.shortlist: 15 physical scenes / 37 objects per layout: 14 static scenes / 33 targets and one 4-object version-2 temporal scene. Four static frames and 12 temporal frames give 68 samples per layout, 204 across three layouts.
definitions.confirmation: Frames 0/1 are retained but excluded from scored accuracy. Frames 2/3 and every later temporal frame are genuine distinct native acquisitions.
definitions.latest_static: Exactly frame 3 per static scene: 28 target rows per layout for coarse, 33 for shortlist. Repeated static frames and temporal continuations do not increase these physical-target denominators; targets sharing a scene are not claimed statistically independent.
definitions.all_scored: Both static frames 2/3 plus temporal frames 2–11: 86 target-frame rows per coarse layout (56+30), 106 per shortlist layout (66+40). All missing, unknown and severe cases remain in overall accuracy.
definitions.classification: Correct detection and exact primitive class divided by every expected row, including misses and unknowns. Recall counts matched unknown observations as detected.
definitions.geometry: Errors are conditional on correct classification, with each distribution retaining its sample count. Cube dimensions compare horizontal long/short sides plus Z, with height separate. Sphere radius is separate from diameter.
definitions.yaw: After major horizontal-axis correspondence, rectangles use 180-degree symmetry and exact squares 90 degrees. The max(1 mm, 2% footprint span) near-square category is evaluation ambiguity, not runtime policy. Raw errors remain saved. Unscored/ambiguous counts include missing and wrong-class boxes.
definitions.visibility: Sufficient visibility requires at least 30 fused 2 mm source samples and 0.18 area-weighted visible physical surface above the 4 mm table crop. Analytic surface quadrature is supported by exclusive current native-depth pixels. This is sampled surface coverage, not a point-count percentage or proof of complete dimensions.
definitions.strict_one_view: Exactly zero raw truth-surface points in one camera and at least eight in the other. Effective one-view is a separate threshold and can permit 1–7 points in the other view.
definitions.recovery: Saved capture-to-capture interval from first reappearance with at least eight raw union samples to correct detection. Full hiding means zero samples in both views. A new full hiding interval censors earlier unresolved visible failures. Zero ms means accepted on the first reappearance capture, excluding processing/delivery.
definitions.matching: One-to-one center match within 40 mm. Mixed/false-split support needs at least eight points and 10% cloud support from each truth object. Every raw observation, including unmatched observations, is retained.
definitions.native_timing: Twelve measured source-only samples per coarse layout: one per static scene after three fresh warmups, with eight rendered steps. Render+source Hz excludes comparisons, truth scoring and exports. Sparse screening timings are not final throughput evidence; failing layouts may process fewer accepted objects. No shortlist timing was acquired.
definitions.comparison: Matched physical scenes across layouts have different images. Identical original frames are used among methods within a layout. Camera selection used the preserved baseline source, before geometric refinement. Final source/holdout/profile results are outside this artifact.
definitions.status: PASS means the experiment completed with valid fixtures, stable run hashes and source contracts. It neither enforces 95% accuracy nor authorizes manipulation.

selection_rationale: Selected once from the independent shortlist; no further camera search.
Tied the best coarse static result, 26/28, with asymmetric_high_left. All four edge targets were correct, versus three for the original layout.
Independent shortlist static accuracy was 31/33, versus 30/33 for front_lower and 28/33 for asymmetric_high_left. All 33 selected-layout targets meet the declared sufficient-visibility criterion.
Selected-layout temporal accuracy was 40/40 with stable IDs and a correctly classified strict one-view object. Complete hiding was not achieved in the selected layout.
Frontal alternatives provide separate genuine full-hide/same-ID recovery evidence. That does not establish selected-layout full-hiding validation.
The choice preserves exact original Camera A and moves only B to (0.18, 0.80, 0.65) m.
The remaining static failure is one missing and one unknown nearby box in three_pairs_gap8. No false positives, known mixed clouds, duplicate IDs or identity switches occurred.
The preferred symmetric-front hypothesis was explicitly tested: 22/28 coarse static correct, so it was not selected.
Selected-layout coarse 4.135 Hz is a small pre-refinement screening measurement, not the final dedicated profile.
This is the best tested practical arrangement on limited selection data, without a global-optimum or statistical-significance claim.

coarse.recommended_future_precondition: Physics/render-only settling: every tracked link remains within0.1mm and0.01deg of beginning of60-consecutive-step window, AABBcoordinate within0.1mm; bounded600steps, fail audit ifneverstable. No controllers/robotpose changes.

settling.snapshot_scope: One resolved robot snapshot per trial, not every depth frame; no intra-trial stability claim.
settling.mesh_caveat: Native BBox valid and resolved link transforms available; descendant_meshes=0 so this artifact does not enumerate individual mesh bounds.

manipulation_scope: Historical manipulation NO-GO remains unaffected; no robot/backend commands in these studies.
